title: General calculus type preservation and checked nine-body lowering relation
summary: Four independently rebuilt Lean modules, thirteen audits, nine concrete typed bodies; source AST transcription remains explicit.

IMPORT-MARKER: PH5-MILESTONE-76/typing-lowering
Root74 independently compiled CalculusTyping, CalculusLowering, CalculusTypeCheck and CalculusTypingAxioms with direct pinnedLean4.31.0, one thread,3GiB cap, four exit0 receipts. Thirteen exact named axiom audits use only propext/Classical.choice/Quot.sound. Preservation covers typed environments, state attributes, returns and exceptions for the supported statement forms; failure is explicitly permitted, so general range/nonfailure progress is not claimed. Sound decidable checker establishes nine real exported bodies under concrete bytes/int-list/int schema. Kernel lowering_checked relates a hand-transcribed spec AST to nine exported bodies; machine-produced AST identity and proof of OCaml source semantics remain open.
